label: Finding-9
title: leak-video: 'around 20:00 UTC' may be the pre-announcement's time, not the video's
description: The Foundation sentence reads 'As a result of the leak and pre-announcement around 20:00 UTC, Calif ... mistakenly published a video.' The time can modify the pre-announcement (oss-security relayed it at 20:22:51Z; php.net's feed says 20:32Z). The Register reads it as 'a couple of hours later' than 15:00; Feross says 'that evening'. The site (claim and timeline.json at 2026-10-20T20:00Z) presents 20:00 UTC as the video's time. Say 'evening of 20 October' or flag the ambiguity.
